actions.name: HubSpot CRM Assistant - Message Handler
actions.description: Route each incoming chat message to the HubSpot CRM Agentic Worker (dw.agent) and reply with its answer

files.content:
pack_id: agentic-hubspot-crm-demo
version: 0.1.0
kind: application
publisher: Greentic
components: []
dependencies: []
flows:
- id: on_message
  file: flows/on_message.ygtc
  tags:
  - default
  entrypoints:
  - default
agents:
  hubspot_assistant:
    agent_id: hubspot_assistant
    system_prompt: "You are a HubSpot CRM assistant running as an Agentic Worker inside a Greentic flow. You help a sales and customer-success team manage their HubSpot CRM: contacts, deals, companies, and support tickets. Use hubspot_contacts, hubspot_deals, hubspot_companies, and hubspot_tickets (each takes an operation of create, search, update, or get) and hubspot_associate to link two records. Always search before creating a record to avoid duplicates. Always confirm with the user before an update or an association, because those change existing data. After any create or update, report the record id and its HubSpot URL. Answer concisely in the user's language. Never invent record ids, properties, or results — only report what the tools return."
    tools:
      - extension_id: greentic.hubspot
        tool_name: hubspot_contacts
      - extension_id: greentic.hubspot
        tool_name: hubspot_deals
      - extension_id: greentic.hubspot
        tool_name: hubspot_companies
      - extension_id: greentic.hubspot
        tool_name: hubspot_tickets
      - extension_id: greentic.hubspot
        tool_name: hubspot_associate
    guardrails: []
    llm:
      provider: deepseek
      model: deepseek-chat
      credential_ref: deepseek
    limits:
      max_iter: 8
      timeout: 120

id: default
title: HubSpot CRM Assistant - Message Handler
description: Route each incoming chat message to the HubSpot CRM Agentic Worker (dw.agent) and reply with its answer
type: messaging
start: assistant

nodes:
  # The single logic node: an Agentic Worker (dw.agent). `operation` selects
  # which embedded agent runs (must match an agent_id under pack.yaml `agents:`).
  # The agent receives the user's message text as `user_text` and returns `reply`.
  assistant:
    dw.agent:
      user_text: "{{in.input.text}}"
    operation: hubspot_assistant
    routing:
      - to: send_reply

  # Builtin reply node — routes the agent's answer back to the active channel.
  send_reply:
    emit.response:
      messages:
        - type: text
          text: "{{node.assistant.reply}}"
    routing:
      - out: true

provider_id: agentic-hubspot-crm-demo
version: 1
title: HubSpot CRM Assistant — credentials
description: API keys for the agentic worker and its HubSpot CRM tools.
questions:
  - name: deepseek
    title: DeepSeek API key
    kind: string
    required: true
    secret: true
    help: "LLM API key for the agentic worker's reasoning loop (https://platform.deepseek.com)."
    group: LLM
    docs_url: "https://platform.deepseek.com"
    placeholder: "sk-..."
  - name: access_token
    title: HubSpot Private App token
    kind: string
    required: true
    secret: true
    help: "HubSpot Private App access token used by the hubspot_* tools (https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/api/private-apps)."
    group: Tools
    docs_url: "https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/api/private-apps"
    placeholder: "pat-..."
